# A Garbage-Collector Layer Between Claude Code Projects

> A Claude Code project works from a picture of your code that quietly stops being true. Six rules keep the managing files honest with the content they manage, and the owner of each project does the collecting.

By Niv Dvir. Published 2026-09-08, last revised 2026-09-11. About 3,709 words.

The six laws quoted in this article are reproduced verbatim from the constitution the projects actually run on, not paraphrased.

## The article

- [A Garbage-Collector Layer Between Claude Code Projects](https://nivdvir.github.io/): If you want your projects to work together, someone has to keep their records honest. No runtime does it. Six rules, and the owner of each project does the collecting..
- [Full text as plain markdown](https://nivdvir.github.io/llms-full.txt): the same article without site chrome.

## What it covers

- The six laws

- What transfers
- Reading, most useful first
